name: Annapurna Scheme
target_group: Eligible BPL senior citizens who are not receiving old-age pension
eligibility: Eligibility is subject to NSAP/Annapurna conditions and state implementation.
benefits: Up to 10 kg of food grains per month for eligible senior citizens not receiving old-age pension, subject to current rules.
application_process: Apply/contact the designated local/state authority implementing NSAP/Annapurna.
source: Ministry of Rural Development / Government of India
